headlines.text: Looking back to 2023, when Adam Cole vs. MJF met in an Eliminator Match, kicking off the show on Dynamite, rated 8.59 ? a match that lived up to every bit of hype.
2024 brought us this moment: PAC vs. Jay Lethal closed out Rampage, rated 6.34 in a hard-fought men's division clash.

It was 2023 when Matt Jackson chalked up their 100th recorded AEW match ? a milestone worth celebrating, facing Young Bucks & Page vs. Castagnoli, Moxley & Yuta, topping the bill that night on Dynamite, rated 8.06 ? a fantastic contest in a fast-paced six-man clash.

secondaries.text: On a Wednesday in 2023, back when Sting was back in action after just under 3 months away, appearing on Dynamite.
Back on this day in 2023, Jake Hager made their return to AEW television after 6 weeks away, appearing on Dynamite.
2023 brought us this moment: Toni Storm vs. Skye Blue fought tooth and nail for the AEW Women's World Title, appearing on Dynamite, rated 5.82.
